mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlists ( watchlist_id, account_id, instrument_id, added_at ) VALUES ( #{watchlistId}, #{accountId}, #{instrumentId}, #{addedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT w.watchlist_id AS watchlistId, w.instrument_id AS instrumentId, i.ticker AS symbol, i.name AS instrumentName, w.added_at AS addedAt FROM watchlists w INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = w.instrument_id WHERE w.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY w.added_at DESC
